[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Vorr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], secretly supporting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. He was killed along his men in [[3643 BBY]], by a promising [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|sergeant]], acting as a distraction and occupying the Sergeant long enough for the defecting [[Havoc Squad]] to escape.
